agent.brief: Layer 1 of the design doc and the index: the overview around the main table: pitch, pillars, the machine, core loop, rules and every topic, with the shot map in the middle. A showcase of the whole design on one page. Facts live in bible.json; pitch, topic names and status dots are bound to it.
rules: Change design decisions in bible.json, not only on this page.
The table (layers Table and Shots, group "group-table") comes from the shot map; its pieces are vault blocks: edit them on Fab.

elements.text: Draft for Pinball Crawl. 21 × 42 in, 1 tile = 1 in.
Skill shot: flippers move the lit lane.
Loops over the top to the right orbit.
Wire return to the left inlane.
Outlane = drain. Inlane feeds the flipper.
Mob nest: every hit earns gold.
Wire return to the right inlane.
Break the 4 mobs (drop targets); the saucer opens the dungeon.
Shoot the one you can afford.

elements.name: pillar card: never out of sight
pillar accent: never out of sight

elements.text: Real weight, always a step toward a goal.
Physics untouched, flippers only. RPG in the abstract.
The area map, always fully on screen. Easy near the flippers, harder at the top.
After dungeon 2: the dragon returns to its lair. Flames, 2 of 4 town buildings destroyed, new trash mobs, a trick shot opens the lair.

elements.name: loop arrow: dungeon opens → drop in
loop arrow: loot → pop back up

elements.text:
1 wizard, 3 lives from the amulet. Permadeath.

Any drain costs a life, both flipper items and all gold. The map stays.

A dungeon exit stays sealed until its encounter is beaten.

Each flipper holds 1 item. Effects happen on impact; physics never change.

Dungeon loot: hit 1 of 3 targets. It goes to the last flipper that touched the ball. Or exit with nothing.

Shop: shoot the item you can afford, the ball holds, press a flipper to equip that side.
